knobs.note: Read by bin/box-console-commands.sh as ${BOX_CONSOLE_COMMANDS_CLAIM_LIMIT:-10}: the most forwarded console commands one claim takes. The lane claims 4 times a minute, so this times 4 is the per-box ceiling per minute.

Read by bin/box-console-commands.sh as ${BOX_CONSOLE_COMMANDS_TTL_S:-300}: a claimed row whose created_at is older than this is refused as expired instead of run. A row with no created_at runs; the hub's expire owns those.
